title: Pudding and Souse
description: Pudding and Souse is a dish from Barbados featuring pork knuckle, yellow onion, thyme, sweet potato. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used. The pudding is made as sweet-potato mash and the souse from pork knuckle; a traditional sweet-potato pudding often uses seasoned grated tuber and a casing.

steps.instruction: Combine these ingredients in a pot, bring just to a boil and skim any foam. Simmer gently for about 95 minutes to make a flavorful base.
Cook the listed ingredients in simmering water for about 25 minutes until tender; drain well if necessary.
Drain the cooked ingredients and pound or mash while warm for about 10 minutes until thick, elastic and smooth; shape into portions with wet hands or a spoon.
Refrigerate the prepared mixture for about 55 minutes, cooling perishable foods promptly and never holding cooked rice warm at room temperature.
Fold in the dressing ingredients, season to taste and serve, or chill briefly as appropriate.
